frequency_question: How often have emergency domestic production lines for advanced missiles been established and operational within a 4-month window?
membership_rule: Includes sovereign states setting up new domestic assembly or manufacturing lines for previously imported guided missiles/cruise missiles under emergency/wartime pressure. Excludes standard peacetime military procurement or mere maintenance/repair depots.

cases.name: Ukraine Neptune missile domestic serial production setup (2022-2023)
Taiwan Hsiung Feng III production line expansion and domestic scaling (2020-2022)
Ukraine Vilkha-M rocket local manufacturing adaptation (2022-2023)
Russian domestic assembly line setup for Iranian-designed Shahed-136 (Alabuga facility, 2023)
Ukraine domestic FPV and loitering munition scaled industrial lines (2023-2024)

provenance_note: 5 cases named, 10 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (2.0x)
coverage_note: 5 documented instances of rapid domestic high-tech missile/munitions line establishment under severe wartime/emergency constraints, out of an estimated 10 major attempts globally in modern high-intensity conflict scenarios.
known_gaps: Classified domestic programs in smaller nations or non-transparent states are difficult to verify precisely by date of operational status.
skeleton: Emergency wartime domestic defense manufacturing establishment cases matching technology transfer complexity and compressed timelines.
multiplier: 5 hits out of 10 estimated total relevant wartime rapid-adaptation efforts for high-tech munitions
validity_reason: Industrial manufacturing technology, digital tooling, and rapid prototyping capabilities evolve gradually over multi-year technological cycles.
